metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: Personal agent skills: coding standards, UI polish, browser checks and the review-to-PR shipping flow.
metadata.author: zainzafar90

skills.name: react-standards
skills.description: Enforces React naming, component and route structure, state ownership, readability, and test-first development.

skills.name: ocd
skills.description: A last-mile perfection pass on screens and code: UI polish, folder structure, naming, spacing, API and web consistency, security, speed and scale, share previews, and leftovers.

skills.name: lean
skills.description: Cuts the current change down to the least code that works, strips comments that narrate the code, and applies the fixes.

skills.name: commit
skills.description: Makes one-line commits on a human-named branch with no Co-Authored-By or AI attribution, and strips attribution from commits not yet pushed.

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Takes a finished branch through review, UI checks, cleanup, commits, and a PR description in one run.

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Reviews a pull request read-only and reports at most five confirmed findings with ready-to-apply suggestion blocks.

skills.name: pr-description
skills.description: Writes a short, scannable PR title and description from the current branch.

skills.name: browser-verify
skills.description: The definition of done for browser-facing changes. It drives the change in a real browser and tries to break it.

skills.name: coding-standards
skills.description: Shared rules for readable, safe code in any language. The base the other standards skills build on.

skills.name: api-standards
skills.description: Server-side standards for handlers, authorization, persistence, integrations, webhooks and workers.

skills.name: frontend-standards
skills.description: Frontend standards for UI features, navigation, client state, forms, data fetching and accessibility.

skills.name: typescript-standards
skills.description: A grep-checkable TypeScript review list for file size, `any`, exports, comments, config and lockfiles.

skills.name: code-spacing
skills.description: Adds and enforces blank lines between declarations and logical blocks, so every file reads in vertical steps.

skills.name: read-me-right
skills.description: Writes a crafted, short README: centred logo, one-line pitch, hero screenshot, the main jobs step by step, and everything else folded into collapsible sections, all checked against the code.
